answer: Faiths & Beliefs >> Innovations & Customs Question ID: 1038 Country: India Title: Wearing sehera on the day of marriage for man is necessary or unislamic? Question: Wearing sehera on the day of marriage for man is necessary or unislamic? Answer ID: 1038 Posted on: Aug 31, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 705/705=J) Wearing sehra is an un-Islamic custom; therefore it is not allowed: قال رسول اللہ صلی اللہ علیہ وسلم: من تشبہ بقوم فھو منھم (رواہ احمد، ابو داؤد: مشکوہ ص 357) Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
